        Meet the founder behind TaknikAI’s career-first learning

        FN Replace https://taknikai.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Shivam.jpeg with the real founder image.
        Founder Story

        TaknikAI was created for learners who want practical skills, not just lectures.

        The idea behind TaknikAI is simple: students should learn tools, build projects, prepare portfolios, and become interview-ready.

        The founder built this platform to close the gap between traditional learning and actual industry expectations. Every module is designed around execution, mentorship, and career clarity.

        From Excel, SQL, Power BI, Python, AI tools, dashboards, portfolio building, and interview preparation — the focus remains on creating visible proof of skill.

        Vision of TaknikAI

        To make modern analytics and AI-assisted learning accessible, practical, project-based, and career-focused for students and working professionals.

        01
        Learn by building Tools, dashboards, case studies, and project execution.
        02
        Mentorship with clarity Guidance for doubts, career direction, and project feedback.
        03
        Career-ready output Portfolio, certificates, interview prep, and job readiness.
        Founder-Led Direct learning vision and guidance
        Project-First Portfolio-ready practical outcomes
        AI-Ready Modern analyst workflow training

        Data Science

        What is data science?

        Data science is a field of computer science that uses various algorithms, methods, and machine learning to uncover hidden and meaningful insights in both structured and unstructured data.

        Is data science easy to learn?

        Data science can be challenging, as it requires a solid understanding of mathematics, statistics, and programming. However, with dedication and the right resources, it’s accessible to those willing to learn.

        Who is a Data Scientist?

        A data scientist is an expert in data science who specializes in collecting and analyzing large amounts of data from diverse sources. They use their skills in mathematics, statistics, and computer science to help organizations make informed decisions based on data analysis.

        How do I become a Data Scientist?

        To become a Data Scientist, follow these steps:

        • Learn the fundamentals of programming and statistics.
        • Acquire knowledge in machine learning and data analysis.
        • Build a strong portfolio of projects.
        • Pursue relevant courses.
        • Apply for Data Scientist positions.
        How is a Data Scientist different from a Data Analyst?

        A Data Scientist designs new data approaches, while a Data Analyst interprets existing data. Data Scientists create innovative ways to collect and analyze data, while Data Analysts extract insights from available data.
